translations.web: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.
translations.bsb: This is the law for someone who has a skin disease and cannot afford the cost of his cleansing.”
translations.kjv: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
